li.label: heard the seer's reading
li.description: A seer sat with me and told me what the next season will bring. It is good to know what is coming.

li.label: turned the same way as everything
li.description: At midnight I stopped and turned to face the same way as everyone else and every animal, and I don't know why I did it.

li.label: put my hand on the humming stone
li.description: I put my hand on the stone while it was humming and felt it in my arm. It was strange, but it calmed me.

li.label: dreamt about the humming stone
li.description: I slept near the stone while it was humming and dreamt about it all night. It was not a bad dream.

li.label: filled with power
li.description: Last night the sky was full of power and some of it went into me. I feel stronger for it.

li.label: saw the dead walk past
li.description: At dusk I saw pale figures walking across the land in a line, and they looked like the dead. I keep thinking about it.

li.label: pilgrims prayed here
li.description: Pilgrims on the road stopped at our place to pray before they went on. It was good to see.

li.label: saw another sky
li.description: Last night the sky was the wrong colour and the stars were not where they should be. It was strange, and very beautiful.

li.label: an animal spoke to me
li.description: A wild animal walked up to me and said something, and I heard it clearly. I don't know what to make of it.

GameConditionDef.label: another sky
GameConditionDef.description: At night the sky has different colours and the stars are not where they should be. Colonists stargaze more often, and enjoy it more.
GameConditionDef.endMessage: The night sky looks as it should again.
